1. EXACT SOURCE AND SCOPE

e²+x²=U², e²+y²=V², x²+y²=z², R²=e²+x²+y²,

The count is an upper bound on actual selector-qualified endpoints, whether any exist or not.
Define W=UV−eR>0 (A44 Wminus). Since 0<U,V<R≤B, W<B². A44 row725 proves for every fixed positive integer W, the number of original normalized full-four-square points is bounded by tau(2W)²; bounded edge permutations only cost an absolute multiplicative constant. Importantly A44 bound is valid including R prime powers and arbitrary omega, and already accounts for A43 fixed-W collisions.
For k≥2, call m k-full if every prime divisor occurs to exponent at least k; m=1 is k-full. For h≥1, define the RECEIVER E_{k,H}(B) of original points P for which W=h m with 1≤h≤H and m k-full, with no coprimality requirement and no uniqueness claim for the factorization. High-W receiver additionally requires W > X_B=B^(1/3)/(1+logB)^(3+κ), κ>0, and hence is disjoint from A44 low-W sector. Bounds apply equally to the full E and its high-W subset.
2. THEOREM A47.1 — ACTUAL PHYSICAL ONE-THIRD SAVING ON THIS HIGH-W PACKET
For every fixed k≥2, ε>0, B≥3, H≥1:
N_original(E_{k,H}(B)) ≪_{k,ε} B^(2/k+ε) H^(1−1/k)
(uniform when 1≤H≤B²; if H≫B² this upper bound still holds but not useful). In particular for k=7 and any fixed 0<η<1/18, choose H=B^(1/18−η):
N_original(E_{7,H}(B)) = O_η(B^(1/3−3η/7)) = o(B^(1/3)).
The exponent 3η/7 is a safe choice after absorbing the B^ε divisor bound; raw exponent is 1/3−6η/7+ε.
This is an unconditional scoped count of EXACT SAME-P original full-four-square objects, including its explicitly high-W intersection. It does NOT imply #P(B)=o(B^(1/3)) unless an independent theorem puts ALL uncounted physical endpoints in this rare W-structure packet. No such theorem is established; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT remains 0. No actual positive full-original example or occupied high-W label is asserted.

(1) A44's two identities (U+V)²−(R+e)²=(R−e)²−(V−U)²=2W give two ordered factor pairs of 2W. Each pair choice reconstructs R,e,U,V and at most one x,y; the fourth original face square is an additional FILTER. Therefore F(W)≤τ(2W)²≪_ε W^ε. With W<B², F(W)≪_ε B^(2ε), constants absorb normalization.
(2) For k-full m, for each p^a||m (a≥k), write a=k b if a≡0(mod k), or a=k(b−1)+(k+j), j∈{1,...,k−1} otherwise. This yields m=A^k∏_{j=1}^{k−1}B_j^{k+j}, B_j pairwise-coprime squarefree (restrictions can be dropped for an upper bound). Hence
#{m≤X:m k-full} ≤ X^(1/k) ∏_{j=1}^{k−1}ζ(1+j/k) =C_k X^(1/k).
(3) Count represented W=h m≤B² by overcounting all h≤H and k-full m≤B²/h:
#{W} ≤C_k B^(2/k)∑_{h≤H}h^(−1/k)≪_k B^(2/k)H^(1−1/k).
Multiply once by A44 fixed-W F(W)≪ B^ε. No independence or density multiplication is used.
(4) k=7,H=B^(1/18−η): exponent 2/7+(6/7)(1/18−η)+ε=1/3−6η/7+ε. Take ε=3η/7, yielding O_η(B^(1/3−3η/7)).

Therefore mere LABEL SUPPORT cardinality plus A44 O(B^o) fixed fibers cannot force o(B^(1/3)) at k≤6: at k=6 this support envelope is order B^(1/3), for k<6 larger. This statement is a lower bound on RELAXED LABELS ONLY, NOT on actual physical points or occupied labels. For k=7 the 2/7 threshold is sharp for this relaxed support-counting mechanism. More generally power exponent 1/3−6η/7 is genuine only for the rare W receiver, not the unrestricted residual.

Every candidate's complete prime factorization checked all exponents≥7. All counts are far below a constant times X^(1/7) as expected, with no implication for actual P occupancy. Chosen independent analytic high-Wminus occupancy via A44 divisor-fiber × k-full sparse label enumeration. Executed exact proof, threshold k=7, and arithmetic SPF crosscheck. It produces a genuine new scoped SAME-P one-third saving but does NOT materially reduce the generic original high-W barrier. This is a 30-record strategy audit, NOT a formal route-switch audit. NEW ALL-HEIGHT THEOREM A46.1

from math import isqrt
def split_primes(lo,hi):

CURRENT=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229HI-A45; PREVIOUS=A44 index row725; TARGET_CANONICAL_INDEX_ROW=726. DOCUMENT_ID=1nGveLu6B9Gg6N1vO7bDebqmNDgZHti2xa_FiqEQL2m0.

STRICT SCOPE / MATHEMATICAL OBJECT:
Let C(B) be normalized positive primitive integral SIX-TUPLES (e,x,y,U,V,R) with 0<x≤y, gcd(e,x,y)=1, R≤B, e²+x²=U², e²+y²=V², e²+x²+y²=R². These are actual integer points of the THREE DISPLAYED square equations and comprise a *superpopulation* of original selected SAME-P. The THIRD face x²+y²=z² is NOT part of this definition; without that check the core is NOT an original primitive Euler brick/perfect cuboid. This critical distinction is carried throughout this card. Original HIGH/sf(G0)/Kcross/rad(Sd)/q/Gres/K-null/EX, source FJ/FO assignment, and all other full physical selectors remain unverified on C(B). Define Wminus=UV−eR>0, Gstar=gcd(eR,xy), Kstar=sf(Gstar), the squarefree kernel. A44 fixed-W divisor bound applies to this larger C(B), but cannot be turned into the full selected high-W occupied count merely by observing C(B).


COMPUTATION: independent exact re-execution at B=1,000,000.
Generate all primitive Euclid triangles with coprime m>n>0, opposite parity, hypotenuse h=m²+n²≤B and all k≤B/h; append both directions k(m²−n²)↔k(2mn) as common leg e / other leg. Group by the common leg e; for every x≤y in each group test R²=e²+x²+y² by integer isqrt, R≤B, and gcd(e,x,y)=1. Completeness: any point of C(B) has two integral right triangles sharing e, so both appear; x≤y normalization prevents exchange duplicates. Integer equalities, gcd, and trial-division primality/factorization are exact, not floating empirical approximations.
Exact output C(200000)=116 (matches A43); C(1000000)=255 (ALREADY KNOWN source superpopulation count in earlier M3-T11-207 row436 and M3-T11-160; NOT a new population count). 255 points occupy 254 distinct Wminus values; only duplicated Wminus=70,045,440, precisely A43's pair, multiplicity2.

Disjoint Wminus intervals at B=10^6 with endpoints (0,10^6], (10^6,10^8], (10^8,10^10], (10^10,10^12]:
ALL C(B): (18,51,111,75), sum255.
SQUAREFREE SPLIT pqr core: (9,20,38,26), sum93.
pqr and Kstar>B^(1/3−0.05) core: (9,19,36,25), sum89.
ALL core with Kstar>B^(1/3−0.05): (16,48,108,72), sum244.
Thus 64/93 pqr core Wminus>10^8; 61/89 high-Kstar pqr core Wminus>10^8. These are FINITE, precisely defined, primitive integral-3-square-core occupied-value counts. The raw B1m size is pre-existing; new calculation here is Wminus/Kstar/pqr joint distribution, not global counting saving.


DIRECT MISSING THIRD FACE PHYSICAL FILTER:
For every one of these 255 C(10^6) tuples independently calculate z=isqrt(x²+y²) and require z²=x²+y². EXACTLY 0 of 255 pass. In particular 0/93 pqr-core and 0/89 pqr-high-Kstar core pass. Consequently the FULL ORIGINAL P with all three face diagonals integral plus space diagonal R integral, R≤10^6, and all additional selectors has zero points in this enumerated 3-equation enclosing set. This is a rigorously finite exclusion, NOT an unbounded theorem or any new one-third exponent; no external completeness or hostile FJ/FO source map is needed to infer the finite empty subset. The label “physical core” used in A43/A44 is never a certificate that the third face is square. It means strictly that the THREE listed integer equations hold. Do not credit the 93/89/61 as original P or as actual selector-qualified occupied high W values.


REPLAY CODE (Python 3 standard library; mathematical loops executable verbatim):
from math import gcd,isqrt
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def census(B):
  legs=defaultdict(set)
  for m in range(2,isqrt(B)+2):
    for n in range(1,m):
      if gcd(m,n)!=1 or (m-n)%2==0: continue
      h=m*m+n*n
      if h>B: continue
      a,b=m*m-n*n,2*m*n
      for k in range(1,B//h+1):
        legs[k*a].add(k*b);legs[k*b].add(k*a)
  points=[]
  for e,S in legs.items():
    L=sorted(S)
    for i,x in enumerate(L):
      for y in L[i:]:
        z=e*e+x*x+y*y;R=isqrt(z)
        if R<=B and R*R==z and gcd(gcd(e,x),y)==1:
          U=isqrt(e*e+x*x); V=isqrt(e*e+y*y)
          W=U*V-e*R
          assert W>0 and U*U==e*e+x*x and V*V==e*e+y*y
          points.append((e,x,y,U,V,R,W,gcd(e*R,x*y)))
  return points
def factors(N):
  d=2; f={}
  while d*d<=N:
    if N%d==0:
      a=0
      while N%d==0: N//=d;a+=1
      f[d]=a
    d+=1 if d==2 else 2
  if N>1:f[N]=1
  return f
def sf(N):
  q=1
  for p,a in factors(N).items():
    if a%2:q*=p
  return q
B=1000000
C=census(B)
assert len(C)==255 and len({v[6] for v in C})==254
PQR=[v for v in C if len(factors(v[5]))==3 and all(a==1 and p%4==1 for p,a in factors(v[5]).items())]
HIGH=[v for v in PQR if sf(v[7])>B**(1/3-0.05)]
assert len(PQR)==93 and len(HIGH)==89
assert sum(isqrt(v[1]**2+v[2]**2)**2==v[1]**2+v[2]**2 for v in C)==0
bounds=[0,10**6,10**8,10**10,10**12]
def bins(L):return [sum(bounds[i]<v[6]<=bounds[i+1] for v in L) for i in range(4)]
assert bins(C)==[18,51,111,75]
assert bins(PQR)==[9,20,38,26]
assert bins(HIGH)==[9,19,36,25]


WHOLE CARD-INDEX + NEGATIVE-REGISTER LOOP / STRATEGY AUDIT:
Screened all canonical CARD-INDEX source rows2:725 (724 historical records) by mathematical objects and tags plus bounded A,E:I search. Relevant previous 229AR row509 already Wminus squareclass, but not occupied high-W. A43 row724 already C(200k)=116 and W collision, A44 row725 fixed-W B^o and small W bound. Critically, old M3-T11-207 row436 already gives same raw 255 at R≤1e6: never claim this core number as new. Original full finite source A15 row696 already tests full physical Euler-brick alternate in a different prime first-pair cutoff; general perfect-cuboid finite exclusion is NOT claimed novel without independent all-historic proof comparison. 229EN and 229EP etc rows608:610 already prove small-edge divisor packets, so do NOT reintroduce fixed-edge low packets as novelty.
